column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to produce Islamic Theologists who are competent
to  lead  the  community  under  the  Islamic  law  of
“Shariaa” on all spheres of life ;
to  produce  “Hafidhs”  who  have  learnt  the  Holy
Quran by heart;
to protect Islam;
to  promote  and  foster  unity  within  the  Islamic
community and find solutions of problems of such
community;
to promote the policies of “Sunnath Wal Jamaath”
within the Islamic community;
to promote and foster the policies of the “Sunnath
wal  Jamaath”  based  on  holy  propagation  of
“Thableegu” with the “Fikh” (concepts of the School
of Thought) laws of the “Shafiee Madhhab” and the
belif in “Al Ashariya”; and
to do all such acts and things as are in the opinion of
the Corporation connected to any of the above and
beneficial to the growth of the College.
